Additionally, their core expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang rather than Java (Java appears only marginally), and their German is self-rated as basic while the role requires strong verbal and written German for client-facing insurance consulting work.

Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing) and agile experience
Solid CS degree and proven communication skills via workshops and conference talks
concerns: Severely overqualified for an entry-level role, posing retention and compensation misalignment risks
Only basic German, while the role requires strong German for close client collaboration
Java is listed but not evidenced in recent work; primary stack is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang
